verdict.rationale: Figma ships its own AI agent and Figma Make, so acting as an MCP client is a fair question for this product. However, every MCP item in the pack describes Figma's own MCP server being used by external MCP clients, which is the opposite role. Nothing shows Figma's agent or Make connecting to third-party MCP servers to use their tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
